explanation: Compared against OEIS A234694: a(n) = #{0 < k < n : p = k + prime(n−k) and prime(p) − p + 1 both prime}, conjecture (i) a(n) > 0 for n > 9. The definition uses 1-indexed primes, prime(m) = Nat.nth Nat.Prime (m−1), over k ∈ [1,n). The subtraction prime(p) − p + 1 is exact since prime(p) > p. The tests match the data 0,1,0,2,1. Faithful.
